summary: First-finish smoke testing of Lineup baseball recruiting platform. Backend (11 critical endpoints) and frontend (all 7 routes + navigation) verified end-to-end against public URL. All core functionality works: 20 amateurs seeded, 5 MLB players with live_stats_loaded=true, biomech mock deterministic, PDF report 77KB with valid %PDF magic, filters narrow results, shortlist CRUD works, UI navigates all pages without console errors.
passed: GET /api/stats/summary -> 200, total_players=20, includes regions/positions/avg_biomech
GET /api/players -> 200, envelope {players:[20], count:20}
GET /api/players?position=OF&region=TX&min_ops=1.0&min_exit_velo=95 -> 200, narrows to 2 players (amateur_001, amateur_013)
GET /api/players/amateur_001 -> 200, Jake Morrison, biomech=71, mlb_comp=Freddie Freeman, fit=86
GET /api/players/does_not_exist -> 404
GET /api/mlb-reference -> 200, {mlb_reference:[5]}, all 5 players live_stats_loaded=true (Judge/Trout/Betts/Soto/Freeman)
POST /api/shortlist/{id} -> idempotent (same id twice = single entry)
GET /api/shortlist -> 200, returns ordered list with full player docs
DELETE /api/shortlist/{id} -> 200, removes entry
POST /api/biomech/analyze?player_id=amateur_001 -> 200, score=71, 5 feature_scores with value/elite_avg/z_score, 2 diagnoses, 2 strengths
POST /api/biomech/analyze with file upload -> 200, valid result (score=76 for fake video)
GET /api/players/amateur_001/report -> 200, application/pdf, 77066 bytes, starts with %PDF-1.4
Frontend / -> hero 'SEE THE SWING' visible, CTA explore-recruits navigates to /search
Frontend /search -> 20 rows render via data-testid=row-*, region=TX filter narrows to 4 rows, row click navigates to /player/:id
Frontend /player/:id -> profile loads with Biomech content, Add to Shortlist & Re-run Biomech buttons functional
Frontend /mlb -> 5 mlb-card-* elements render
Frontend /compare -> picker-a and picker-b present
Frontend /shortlist -> page loads (empty state acceptable after toggle)
Frontend /upload -> upload-dropzone visible, Run Biomech Analysis button rendered
Top navigation (nav-search, nav-mlb, nav-compare, nav-shortlist, nav-upload) all functional with active highlight
No console errors during full UI walkthrough
notes: Backend wraps list responses in envelopes ({players, count} and {mlb_reference}) — frontend api.js consumers correctly unwrap these in Search/Compare/MlbReference/Shortlist pages.
Biomech analyze is a deterministic mock as documented — not flagged.
MLB Stats API live fetch succeeded for all 5 reference players during this run.
